final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.weathprofile, s1.avg_bandusagepct, s1.record_count, CAST(s1.record_count AS REAL) / s2.total_count AS count_share FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_group_bandusagepct, AVG(record_count) AS avg_group_count, AVG(count_share) AS avg_group_count_share FROM step3 GROUP BY weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_group_bandusagepct), AVG(avg_group_count), AVG(avg_group_count_share) FROM step4
